data.one_liner: An asset picker widget for images, videos, and audio based on WeChat's UI.
data.what_it_does: Provides a feature-rich, customizable asset picker mimicking WeChat's interface for selecting images, videos, and audio files. It supports accessibility, localization, single and multi-selection, custom sorting, and specific media filtering options.
use_when: You need a WeChat-styled asset picker for images, videos, and audio in your app.
You require advanced customization of themes, text delegates, and sorting for media selection.
avoid_when: You are using a Flutter version older than 3.27 (for version 10.0.0+).
You need a custom non-WeChat native UI design without overriding delegates.
strengths: Complete WeChat UI style with rich customization options.
Full accessibility support with TalkBack and VoiceOver.
Supports multiple media types including images, videos, and audio.
weaknesses: Tight dependency on photo_manager configuration and specific platform permissions.
Strictly tied to the stable version of Flutter.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform permission setups in Android Manifest (e.g. READ_MEDIA_IMAGES) and iOS/macOS Info.plist (NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription), alongside specific minimum platform version requirements.
